AI Engineer Wiki

Welcome to the AI Engineer Wiki

This is a bilingual (English / Spanish) technical documentation designed for AI engineers and distributed systems practitioners.

Content Structure

The wiki is organized into 18 modules divided into two main sections:

Fundamentals

  1. Networking & Internet — OSI model, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, routing, firewalls
  2. Infrastructure & Containers — Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Monitoring
  3. Distributed Systems — Consensus, message queues, distributed caching, event-driven
  4. Operating Systems — Linux internals, kernel, filesystems, memory, syscalls
  5. Programming & Software Engineering — Python, design patterns, testing, Git
  6. Databases — PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, CAP theorem, sharding

Artificial Intelligence

  1. Machine Learning Fundamentals — Supervised learning, neural networks, loss functions
  2. Deep Learning — CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, PyTorch, GPU computing
  3. LLMs — Architecture and Functioning — Tokenization, decoder-only, attention, KV cache
  4. LLMs — Training — Pre-training, RLHF, alignment
  5. LLMs — Evaluation and Benchmarking — MMLU, LM-Eval, hallucination, red teaming
  6. RAG and Vector Databases — Vector embeddings, vector databases
  7. Fine-Tuning — LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, instruction tuning
  8. AI Agents — Tool use, ReAct, agentic frameworks, multi-agent
  9. AI Security — Prompt injection, jailbreaking, guardrails, PII
  10. Cloud and AI Infrastructure — GPU cloud, serverless inference, Terraform
  11. MLOps and Production — Model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML
  12. Multimodal and Computer Vision — ViT, CLIP, diffusion models

Switch languages using the toggle in the navigation bar to access the Spanish version.
